13.name: Whitfield reviews Devin's signature
13.description: Whitfield lifts the page to read Devin's full signature and then squares the document away, signaling he intends to keep it.
evidence: Whitfield finally moved his hand, lifting the page just enough to read Devin's signature in full, and then set it back down squared to the edge of his blotter the way he squared every document he intended to keep.

13.name: Whitfield thanks Asha before the meeting
13.description: Whitfield thanks Asha for bringing the document before the meeting, and Asha reads his wording as a sign that the procedural issue is accepted and the personal matter will stay private.
evidence: "Thank you for bringing this to me before the meeting," he said, and the word he chose was thank you, not we'll discuss, which Asha understood to mean the procedural piece had landed where she needed it to land and the personal piece had been heard and would not be repeated out loud in the next room.

13.name: Whitfield warns Asha about the meeting timing
13.description: Whitfield checks the time and tells Asha she needs to be in her chair before Hatcher's name is raised.
evidence: He glanced at the clock on the credenza. "Six-forty. You'll want to be in your chair before Hatcher's name comes up."

13.name: Asha leaves Whitfield's office
13.description: Asha takes the returned copy and exits into the corridor, heading toward the upcoming conference meeting.
evidence: She nodded, took the copy he slid back toward her, and let herself out into the corridor

13.name: Asha anticipates difficult hearing discussion
13.description: As she walks out, Asha mentally braces for a conference where she must defend the firm's Hatcher placement while exhausted and financially strained.
evidence: where, in eighteen minutes, she would have to sit across a conference table from the woman whose children's hearing was at ten, with a night of no sleep behind her and an empty savings account, and explain why the firm's strategy for the Hatcher placement still held.

13.name: Asha pauses to steady herself
13.description: In the corridor, Asha stops, closes her eyes, and deliberately calms herself so she can enter the conference room composed.
evidence: In the corridor outside Whitfield's office, Asha stopped walking. She closed her eyes for the count of five, felt the floor under her shoes and the dry burn behind her eyelids from the night she had not slept, and let her breath find a rhythm she could carry into the conference room.

13.name: Rosa sends Asha encouragement
13.description: Asha receives a brief text from Rosa telling her to go win, giving her a small boost before the meeting.
evidence: When she opened her eyes the phone at her hip buzzed once: Rosa, two words, Go. Win.

13.name: Asha pockets Rosa's message
13.description: Asha reads Rosa's message and puts the phone away, preparing to continue toward the meeting.
evidence: She read it, slid the phone back into her

13.name: Asha steadies herself before entering
13.description: Asha controls her breathing and composes herself before going into the conference room.
evidence: let her breath find a rhythm she could carry into the conference room

13.name: Rosa sends Asha a brief encouragement
13.description: Asha receives a text from Rosa telling her to go and win, signaling support before the meeting.
evidence: the phone at her hip buzzed once: Rosa, two words, Go. Win.

13.name: Asha ignores the text and heads in
13.description: Asha reads Rosa's message, puts the phone away without replying, and walks toward the conference room.
evidence: She read it, slid the phone back into her pocket without answering, and started toward the room

13.name: Mrs. Hatcher waits with untouched coffee
13.description: Mrs. Hatcher is already in the conference room, waiting with the firm's coffee untouched and unaware of Asha's weekend work.
evidence: Mrs. Hatcher was already waiting with a cup of the firm's coffee and no idea what the lawyer arguing for her children had spent the weekend doing.

13.name: Asha enters and takes control of the meeting
13.description: Asha opens the conference room door, enters calmly, greets Mrs. Hatcher, and sits across from her with the case folder.
evidence: Asha pushed the conference room door open with her shoulder and stepped in
Asha said good morning, took the chair across from her, and laid the folder down

13.name: Asha sets the meeting timeline
13.description: Asha tells Mrs. Hatcher they have less than three hours and that she will explain the order in which she plans to question the caseworker.
evidence: We have a little under three hours
and I want to walk you through the order I'm going to take the caseworker in.

13.name: Asha composes her body language
13.description: Asha deliberately avoids checking her watch and keeps her hands controlled until they settle, projecting calm authority.
evidence: She did not look at her watch, and she did not let her hands return to her lap until they had stopped needing to.

13.name: Asha reviews evidence with Mrs. Hatcher
13.description: Asha opens the folder to receipts and site-visit logs and shows Mrs. Hatcher the dates in sequence as she outlines her questioning strategy.
evidence: Asha opened the folder to the launderette receipts and the caseworker's site-visit log, fanning them so Mrs. Hatcher could see the dates in sequence
and walked her through the order she meant to take the agency witness in—employment timeline first, then the Wednesday and Friday drop-ins

13.name: walks witness through questioning order
13.description: Asha guides the agency witness through the sequence of topics she intends to cover, starting with the employment timeline and moving through the drop-ins and pickup window.
evidence: walked her through the order she meant to take the agency witness in—employment timeline first, then the Wednesday and Friday drop-ins, then the question about the school-pickup window

13.name: withholds Tuesday report contradiction
13.description: Asha keeps the Tuesday report face-down and deliberately avoids naming the conflicting line from Devin's corrected filing.
evidence: She kept the Tuesday report face-down under her left palm and did not name the line in Devin's corrected filing that now ran against it
that was a decision for the room, not for this table

13.name: deletes sent message
13.description: Across town, Rosa deletes the two-word message she had sent earlier and leaves her phone face-down on the counter.
evidence: Across town, in the kitchen where she had drunk two cups of coffee while Asha was still in Whitfield's office, Rosa picked up her phone, opened the thread, and deleted the two words she had sent at six-forty, then set the device face-down on the counter and left it there

13.name: acknowledges exhibit with coffee cup
13.description: Mrs. Hatcher nods through the pages and lifts an untouched coffee, while Asha lets the cup's sound hang in the room before continuing.
evidence: Mrs. Hatcher nodded at each page in turn and finally lifted the coffee she had not touched
Asha let the small sound of the cup against the saucer sit between them before she moved to the next exhibit

13.name: steadies herself for next exhibit
13.description: Asha keeps her hands steady on the folder as she moves on, despite the morning's strain.
evidence: her hands steady on the folder in a way her morning had not earned

13.name: files report away in folder
13.description: Asha moves the Tuesday report to the bottom of the folder and closes it, choosing to keep the decision off the table.
evidence: Asha lifted her left palm from the Tuesday report, slid it face-down to the bottom of the folder, and closed the cover with a small sharp click that landed in the quiet of the conference room
Asha let the decision sit where she had put it, inside the folder rather than on the table between them

13.name: reacts to folder closing
13.description: Mrs. Hatcher looks up at the sharp click of the folder closing, then returns her attention to the coffee cup.
evidence: Mrs. Hatcher looked up at the sound, then back at the coffee cup in her hands

13.name: washes hands after deleting message
13.description: Rosa stands at the counter, runs cold water, and washes her hands slowly after deleting the message.
evidence: Across town, Rosa stood from the counter where her phone still lay face-down, ran the tap until the water was cold, and washed her hands without hurrying

13.name: Rosa washes her hands after avoiding the phone
13.description: Rosa stands from the counter, runs cold water, and washes her hands in a habitual, emotionally loaded way without turning her phone back over.
evidence: Across town, Rosa stood from the counter where her phone still lay face-down, ran the tap until the water was cold, and washed her hands without hurrying, the way she had washed them after every difficult morning in that kitchen for thirty years.
She dried them on the towel by the sink and did not turn the phone back over.

13.name: Asha resumes questioning Mrs. Hatcher
13.description: In the conference room, Asha places her hand on the folder and tells Mrs. Hatcher they will review the school-pickup window again.
evidence: In the conference room, Asha set her hand flat on the closed folder and told Mrs. Hatcher they would walk the school-pickup window one more time.

13.name: Asha presses Mrs. Hatcher for the arrival time
13.description: Asha slides the folder back, lingers with her fingertips, and asks Mrs. Hatcher to repeat the time she arrived at the school on Friday.
evidence: Asha slid the folder back across the table toward Mrs. Hatcher, kept her fingertips on the corner a moment longer than the gesture required, and asked her to say again, in her own words, what time she had pulled up to the school on the Friday in the caseworker's log.

13.name: Mrs. Hatcher repeats the logged time
13.description: Mrs. Hatcher answers with the same arrival time she has given before, and Asha records it carefully in small print.
evidence: Mrs. Hatcher set the coffee cup down and answered, two forty-eight, the way she had answered every other time, and Asha wrote the number on the legal pad in the same small print she used for everything, so the page would not show which line mattered.

13.name: Rosa sends a warning to someone
13.description: Rosa turns her phone face-up and sends a brief message telling someone to trust their instincts, then does not wait for a response.
evidence: Across town, Rosa lifted the phone off the counter, turned it face-up, and typed three words into the thread and sent them: trust your gut.
She did not wait to see the read receipt; she set the phone down screen-up this time and went back to the towel by the sink.

13.name: Asha ignores a phone vibration
13.description: Asha's phone vibrates beside the folder, but she leaves it face-down and continues the interview instead of checking it.
evidence: In the conference room Asha's phone, face-down beside the folder, vibrated once against the wood, and she did not turn it over, only nodded at Mrs. Hatcher and asked her to walk through it one more time f

13.name: Asha ignores phone vibration
13.description: Asha notices her phone vibrate but chooses not to answer it while continuing the client conversation.
evidence: Asha's phone, face-down beside the folder, vibrated once against the wood, and she did not turn it over

13.name: Asha asks for the account again
13.description: Asha asks Mrs. Hatcher to repeat the account from the corner of Twelfth.
evidence: only nodded at Mrs. Hatcher and asked her to walk through it one more time from the corner of Twelfth

13.name: Mrs. Hatcher repeats her account
13.description: Mrs. Hatcher restarts her story from the corner of Twelfth, speaking more steadily after repeating it several times.
evidence: Mrs. Hatcher started again from the corner of Twelfth, her voice steadier now that she had said the time three times in a row

13.name: Asha reads Rosa's message
13.description: Asha turns her phone face-up and reads Rosa's second message saying the Tuesday gap is hers.
evidence: she slid two fingers under the edge of her phone and turned it face-up on the wood. The screen showed Rosa's second message under the first: the Tuesday gap is yours. Asha read it once

13.name: Asha conceals her reaction
13.description: Asha keeps her attention on Mrs. Hatcher and hides any reaction to Rosa's message by setting the phone face-down again.
evidence: kept her eyes on Mrs. Hatcher rather than on the words, and set the phone back face-down beside the folder without any change in her expression

13.name: Client continues discussing pickup window
13.description: Mrs. Hatcher continues talking about the school-pickup window while Asha remains outwardly composed.
evidence: so that the client across the table registered only a small movement of her wrist and went on with the school-pickup window

13.name: Asha marks Tuesday decision internally
13.description: Asha's unresolved decision about whether to raise the Tuesday issue in the hearing settles more firmly into her mind.
evidence: the decision about whether to be the one to name the Tuesday line in the hearing settled a little further into the side of the folder where she had already put it

13.name: Asha ends the review and stands
13.description: After Mrs. Hatcher finishes repeating the account, Asha closes her legal pad and rises from the table.
evidence: Asha let Mrs. Hatcher finish the walk from the corner of Twelfth one final time, then closed the legal pad over the two forty-eight written in her small even hand and stood.

13.name: Asha gathers her materials to leave
13.description: Asha picks up the folder containing the Tuesday report and takes her coat from the chair, preparing to leave the room.
evidence: She picked up the folder with the Tuesday report still face-down at the bottom, gathered her coat from the back of the chair

13.name: Asha stands and gathers her things
13.description: Asha finishes at her desk, picks up the folder with the Tuesday report, takes her coat, and moves toward the conference room door.
evidence: stood. She picked up the folder with the Tuesday report still face-down at the bottom, gathered her coat from the back of the chair, and crossed to the conference room door

13.name: Asha silently escorts Mrs. Hatcher
13.description: Asha holds the door open for Mrs. Hatcher and says nothing about the report or the phone message, maintaining a composed front.
evidence: holding it open for Mrs. Hatcher with the same neutral steadiness she had kept all morning, saying nothing about the line in the report or the message on her phone

13.name: Rosa deletes unsent message
13.description: Across town, Rosa opens her thread to Asha and deletes a half-typed message she had been carrying since the Whitfield meeting.
evidence: Across town, Rosa lifted her phone off the counter, opened the thread to Asha, and deleted without sending the half-typed message she had been carrying since the Whitfield meeting

13.name: Rosa sets phone aside and folds towel
13.description: Rosa puts her phone face-down on the counter and folds the towel over the sink edge, signaling restraint and withdrawal.
evidence: she set the phone face-down on the counter again and folded the towel over the edge of the sink

13.name: Asha guides Mrs. Hatcher to courtroom
13.description: In the corridor, Asha adjusts the folder under her arm and walks Mrs. Hatcher toward the courtroom door without speaking.
evidence: In the corridor outside the conference room, Asha shifted the folder under her arm so the weight of it sat against her ribs and walked Mrs. Hatcher toward the courtroom door without speaking

13.name: Asha pauses at courtroom door
13.description: At the courtroom door, Asha stops and takes a breath that feels incomplete, showing strain beneath her composure.
evidence: At the courtroom door Asha stopped, shifted the folder so the Tuesday report sat flat against her ribs, and took one breath that did not quite fill her chest

13.name: Rosa sends brief support message
13.description: Rosa types 'hold the line' to Asha and leaves the message unsent on the counter, implying a delayed but deliberate attempt to reach her.
evidence: Across town, Rosa picked up the phone, opened the thread, and typed hold the line, then set it face-down on the counter without waiting for anything back

13.name: Asha feels Rosa's message through folder
13.description: Asha senses the phone buzz through the folder instead of her pocket, refuses to look, and tightens her grip until it hurts.
evidence: Asha felt the buzz through the wood of the folder rather than her pocket and did not look; she tightened her grip until the cardstock edge pressed a thin line into the inside of her arm

13.name: Asha opens door for Mrs. Hatcher
13.description: After steadying herself, Asha places her free hand on the door and continues holding it for Mrs. Hatcher.
evidence: and only then did she put her free hand on the door for Mrs. Hatcher

13.name: Asha conceals the cardstock
13.description: Asha keeps the cardstock hidden in her pocket and grips it tightly before entering the courtroom.
evidence: her pocket and did not look; she tightened her grip until the cardstock edge pressed a thin line into the inside of her arm
and only then did she put her free hand on the door for Mrs. Hatcher

13.name: Asha enters the courtroom with Mrs. Hatcher
13.description: Asha opens the door for Mrs. Hatcher and follows her into the courtroom.
evidence: she put her free hand on the door for Mrs. Hatcher
Inside, the courtroom smelled of floor polish and old paper
Mrs. Hatcher went past her toward counsel's row, and Asha followed a half-step behind

13.name: Asha notices the caseworker waiting
13.description: Asha sees the caseworker already seated at the far table with an open binder.
evidence: the caseworker was already at the far table with a binder open to a tab Asha could not yet read

13.name: Asha hides the hearing note
13.description: Asha places her legal pad face-down over the folder, hiding the handwritten 'two forty-eight' from view.
evidence: Asha set the legal pad face-down over the folder at counsel's table, the two forty-eight hidden under blank cardboard

13.name: Asha signals readiness to Mrs. Hatcher
13.description: Asha holds the caseworker's gaze and nods for Mrs. Hatcher to sit, signaling that they are ready.
evidence: kept her hand flat on top of it while she found the caseworker across the aisle and held her gaze a beat longer than greeting required
She nodded once for Mrs. Hatcher to take the chair beside her, a small slow motion that the client read as readiness

13.name: Mrs. Hatcher sits carefully
13.description: Mrs. Hatcher takes the chair beside Asha and arranges her hands in the same careful way as before.
evidence: Mrs. Hatcher sat, folding her hands in her lap in the same careful arrangement she had used at the conference table

13.name: Rosa leaves the kitchen area
13.description: Across town, Rosa squares a towel over the sink, steps into the hallway, and leaves the phone face-down behind her.
evidence: Across town Rosa drew the folded towel the rest of the way over the edge of the sink, squared it once with her palm, and stepped back from the counter into the hallway, leaving the phone face-down behind her

13.name: Asha senses no further contact
13.description: Asha feels that nothing more is coming through the folder and waits for the judge without reacting to Rosa's absence.
evidence: Asha did not feel the absence in any way she could have named, only registered, without looking, that nothing more was coming through the wood of the folder against her ribs
She drew the pad an inch closer under her hand and waited for the judge

13.name: Asha stops checking for more
13.description: Asha senses that nothing else is coming and pauses, waiting for the judge instead of continuing to search for signals.
evidence: without looking, that nothing more was coming through the wood of the folder against her ribs. She drew the pad an inch closer under her hand and waited for the judge.

13.name: Asha hides the number under her hand
13.description: Asha slides the legal pad forward and covers the handwritten number with her fingertips, keeping it concealed.
evidence: Asha slid the legal pad forward an inch under her palm, her fingertips passing over the small two forty-eight in her own hand before settling flat across the numbers. The cardboard hid them again

13.name: Caseworker turns a page
13.description: While Asha stays still, the caseworker across the aisle turns a page in the binder.
evidence: while the caseworker turned a page in the binder across the aisle.

13.name: Rosa covers the phone and leaves
13.description: Across town, Rosa places a folded towel over the face-down phone and walks out of the kitchen into the hallway without looking back.
evidence: Across town, Rosa lifted the folded towel a final time, set it square over the face-down phone, and walked out of the kitchen into the hallway without looking back, leaving the counter quiet behind her.

13.name: Asha accepts the silence as permission
13.description: Asha does not know what Rosa has done, but she interprets the continued silence as permission to stop listening for more.
evidence: Asha did not know any of that, only that nothing further came, and she took the absence as permission to stop listening for it.

13.name: Mrs. Hatcher reads Asha's stillness
13.description: Mrs. Hatcher remains with folded hands and interprets Asha's stillness as the response Asha wants her to see.
evidence: Beside her, Mrs. Hatcher kept her hands folded in her lap and waited, reading Asha's stillness as the thing Asha needed her to read it as.
